scientific_integrity: The full-board torsion is previously known. New result is the exhaustive sharp low-deletion classification. Computations use exact unimodular integer reduction on all 18 symmetry orbit representatives. No independent review is represented.
scientific_limitations: Only integral H_2 of induced chessboard subcomplexes after zero through four vertex deletions; other degrees, larger deletions, homotopy types and inclusion-induced maps are not classified. Originality remains subject to unindexed sources.
title: Sharp four-square deletion threshold for three-torsion in the five-by-five chessboard complex
